input: Consolidate my old 401k into my current plan

gold.taskTitle: Consolidate Old 401k Into Current Employer Plan
gold.taskDescription: Roll over one or more old 401k accounts from previous employers into the user's current employer-sponsored retirement plan.

questions.title: How many old 401k accounts are you consolidating?
questions.description: Determine the number of separate old 401k accounts the user needs to roll over.

questions.title: Do you know which financial institutions hold the old accounts?
questions.description: Identify the custodians or brokerages currently holding the old 401k funds.

questions.title: Have you confirmed your current plan accepts incoming rollovers?
questions.description: Verify whether the current employer's 401k plan allows rollover contributions from outside accounts.

questions.title: Do you want a direct rollover or an indirect rollover?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants funds transferred institution-to-institution or paid out to them first.

questions.title: Are any of the old accounts Roth 401k versus traditional 401k?
questions.description: Determine the tax treatment of the old accounts, as Roth and traditional funds have different rollover rules.

questions.title: What is your target timeline for completing this rollover?
questions.description: Understand any urgency or deadlines the user has in mind for finishing the consolidation.

questions.title: Do you have your current plan account number and administrator contact?
questions.description: Check whether the user already has the key details needed to initiate the receiving side of the rollover.
